# Camping in the World Beyond

## In short
- Your survival chance is calculated **once**, when you hide or dig a tomb. It is saved and is not recalculated before the attack. If the zone gets better after that (for example zombies are killed), you have to leave your hiding place and hide again to benefit [1] [2].
- What helps most:
  - having camped few times before (+80 on your first camp in normal towns);
  - a good ruin with a free spot (Nuclear Bunker +50);
  - being far from town (+5 to +20 from 12 km on);
  - an empty zone (−7 per zombie);
  - hiding at night (+10);
  - the Lighthouse construction (+25).

  The total is capped at 90%. Survivalists can reach 100%, and the highest Reclusive hero skill raises the cap to 99% [3] [4].
- Site improvements stay on the zone and help everyone there, but they lose 15 points every night [5].

## How it works
**Hiding.** The "hide" action and the "tomb" action both run custom effect 10. It does the following [1]:
- saves the current time as your camping timestamp, which sets your priority among the zone's campers;
- saves `getCampingOdds()` as your camping chance;
- makes your dig timers passive;
- releases the citizens you were escorting and removes your own escort settings.

Leaving your hiding place (effect 11) resets the timestamp and the saved chance to 0 [1]. You cannot camp on the town zone (0/0), and camping actions need the town setting `features.camping`  [6].

**Formula.** Chance = clamp(sum of the terms below ÷ 100, 0, cap). The cap is max(1.0 if you are a Survivalist, otherwise 0; the `CampingChanceCap` property, default 0.9) [3] [7].

All terms are in percent [3]:

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Previous nights camped (index = camping counter) | Normal towns: 80, 60, 35, 15, 0. With pro camper: 80, 70, 60, 40, 30, 20, 0. Panda: 50, 30, 20, 10, 0. Panda with pro camper: 50, 45, 40, 30, 20, 10, 0. After the list in every case: −50, −100, −200, −400, −1000, −2000, then −5000 for all further nights |
| Tomb (`tg_tomb`) | +8 |
| Town setting `modifiers.camping.default_bonus` | 0 by default, −30 in panda [8] [9] |
| Zone improvement level | + the level |
| Ruin / terrain | see below |
| Lighthouse `small_lighthouse_#00` built | +25 |
| Each unbroken `camp_bonus` item in your rucksack | +5 |
| Zombies on the zone | −7 each, or −3 each if you wear the camouflage vest `vest_on_#00` |
| Campers who hid here before you | 1st camper: 0, 2nd: 0, 3rd: −10, 4th: −30, 5th: −50, 6th and later: −70 |
| Night | +10 |
| Distance (rounded straight-line km) | 0 km: −100, 1: −75, 2: −50, 3: −25, 4: −10, 5–11: 0, 12: +5, 13: +7, 14: +10, 15: +15, 16 and more: +20 |
| Devastated town | −50 |

- **Night** means the current server hour is outside the daytime range (default [7,18], so 19:00–06:59). The game uses the time at the moment you hide, and it ignores the `features.nightmode` setting [3] [10] [8].
- **Distance** uses `round(sqrt(x²+y²))` [11].

**Ruin / terrain term** [3]:
- An empty desert zone, or a ruin with no free spot for you: **−25**.
- A ruin with a free spot that is still buried under debris: **+15**.
- A ruin with a free spot and no debris left: **the ruin's camping bonus**.

You have a spot if the capacity is negative (unlimited) or if fewer campers hid there before you than the capacity allows. The capacity of a ruin with no debris left is its prototype capacity. A ruin still under debris has min(3, floor(debris ÷ 3)) spots [11]. The desert page shows up to 5 remaining spots.

**Ruin camping bonuses** [list_entities ruin]:

| Ruin | Bonus | Capacity |
|---|---|---|
| Nuclear Bunker | +50 | 5 |
| Old Police Station | +30 | 4 |
| Citizen's Tent | +30 | 1 |
| Army Outpost, 'Shattered Illusions' Bar, Broken-down Tank, Equipped Trench | +20 | — |
| Smugglers' Cache, Strange Barn | +15 | — |
| Most other ruins (including the three explorable ruins) | +10 | — |
| Looted Supermarket | 0 | — |
| Family Tomb | −15 | — |
| Abandoned Well | −20 | — |
| Indian Burial Ground | −50 | unlimited (−1) |

**Example.** Your first camp, at night, in an empty Nuclear Bunker 12 km away in a default town: 80 + 50 + 5 + 10 = 145%. That is capped to 90%, or 100% for a Survivalist [3].

**At the attack** (`stage1_vanish`) [5]:
- The zone's auto-search runs first.
- Anyone outside without `tg_hide` or `tg_tomb` dies (cause: Vanished).
- Each camper rolls their saved chance:
  - **Failure in a normal town:** death (Vanished).
  - **Failure in a devastated town:** you get `tg_camping_death` and are killed in the later `stage2_vanish` step.
  - **Success:** camping counter +1. If the zone's blueprint is still available and the ruin has no debris left, a blueprint drops on the floor: `bplan_u_#00` below 10 km, `bplan_r_#00` at 10 km or more.

**At dawn** [5]:
- Every citizen outside gets the `camper` status, and their camping timestamp and saved chance are reset to 0.
- `camper` gives +10% dig chance on zones that are not depleted [12].
- Each zone's improvement level drops by 15, never below 0.
- Survivors with `camper` get the `r_camp_#00` picto. In a devastated town that has reached day 10 or later, they also get `r_cmplst_#00` [5].

## What changes it
**Survivalist job.** The cap becomes 100% instead of 90% [3] [13].

**Improving the zone** [14] [15]:
- Defence items with the **Install** action add +9 to the zone level each. Each costs 1 AP and consumes the item. Examples: Trestle, Järpen Table, Solid Wooden Board, Mattress, Old Door, Sheet Metal, Sheet of Plywood.
- You cannot do this at the town gate.
- You can only install while the level is below 50, so the level can reach at most 58.
- Improvements can stack (they are added to the level) [16].
- The **Improve your hiding spot** action costs 1 AP and adds +5 to the zone level. It is not possible while tired, hidden or in a tomb.

**Carried items.** Groundsheet `sheet_#00` and Festering Flesh `smelly_meat_#00` have the `camp_bonus` property: +5 each, only when unbroken and in your rucksack [17] [18] [3].

**Camouflage vest worn (`vest_on_#00`).** The zombie penalty drops from −7 to −3 per zombie [3].

**Tomb.** Digging a tomb costs 1 AP and is not possible while tired; hiding is free. The `tg_tomb` status gives +8 [3]. The Labradoodle's "Bury you" action gives `tg_tomb` and hides you. The well-fed Labradoodle's "Bury and hide you" also adds +5 to the zone level, but only while the level is below 50 [19] [20].

**Lighthouse (`small_lighthouse_#00`).** +25 for all citizens. It costs 30 AP, has blueprint level 3 and needs the Watchtower [21].

**Hero skills:**
- **Pro camper.** Uses the gentler table of previous-night penalties, as long as your camping counter is below `ProCamperUsageLimit`, which defaults to 0 [3] [7].
- **Reclusive 0:** pro camper, limit 6 [22].
- **Reclusive 1 and 2:** pro camper, limit 8 [23] [24].
- **Reclusive 3 (80 hero days):** pro camper, limit 8, and camping cap 0.99 [4].
- **Legacy "Pro Camper" skill (301 hero days):** only sets `features.pro.camper` [25].

**Other campers.** Hiding after others on the same zone costs up to −70 and can take the last ruin spots [3].

## Town types
| Town type | Difference |
|---|---|
| Default, small, remote, custom | Their rule differences contain no camping settings. Base bonus 0; previous-night table starts at 80 [26] [27] [28] [8] |
| Panda (Pandemonium) | `modifiers.camping.default_bonus` −30 and `modifiers.camping.map` "hard" [9]. The code also detects the town type 'panda' and uses the smaller tables (first camp +50) [3] |
| Any town | The camping chance also depends on the town setting `features.camping` (camping can be switched off) [6] |

## Related
- **Night watch:** the other way to protect yourself at night. See the watch death chances [29].
- **Debris clearing:** it changes both the ruin capacity and the bonus (+15 while buried, the ruin's own bonus once cleared). The blueprint can only drop once the ruin is cleared [11] [5].
- **Digging:** the `camper` status gives +10% dig chance the next day [12].
- **Help text:** says improvements are capped, that the town gate is the worst place to hide, and describes the "Zen Camper" distinction [2].

## Not verified
- **Basic camping actions:** I could not find how much "Improve the site" (`cm_campsite_improve`) adds to the zone, or the AP costs and requirements of the hide and tomb actions.
- **Order of campers:** I did not read `ZoneRepository::findPreviousCampersCount`. I assume it counts campers on the zone with an earlier camping timestamp.
- **Panda "hard" setting:** `modifiers.camping.map` is not used in `getCampingValues`, so I don't know what it does.
- **Legacy Pro Camper skill:** it does not set `ProCamperUsageLimit`, which defaults to 0. By itself it would therefore never trigger the pro-camper table, unless another source raises the limit.
- **Combining cap or limit values:** how they add up when several sources set them (merge rule `(old+new)−default`) was not tested.
- **Losing the hidden status:** I did not confirm in the code exactly where `tg_hide`/`tg_tomb` are removed at dawn. The help page says you have to hide again each night.
